:::note[Generated]
The `provider_describe` tool as the server lists it in `tools/list`. Generated from turf-mcp-server v1.3.0-8-ga90b39e595 by `scripts/generate-reference.mjs`: change the server, then run `npm run generate`.
:::

Describe one resource type, data source type or action type of a provider — `tofu providers schema`, one type at a time: attribute names, types, descriptions, and whether each is required, optional or computed — or one of its provider-defined functions: parameters, return type and description. Needs no workspace: the provider is installed into the shared plugin cache and asked, so this downloads the provider from its registry when the cache lacks it, and runs it. Turf's own action (turf_action, provider terraform.io/builtin/turf) is described without a version.

**[Tiers](/docs/reference/server/#tiers):** read · plan · apply · full

## Annotations

| Annotation | Value |
|---|---|
| `readOnlyHint` | false |
| `destructiveHint` | false |
| `idempotentHint` | false |
| `openWorldHint` | true |

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | string | no | Provider source (e.g. 'hashicorp/aws'). Pass 'terraform.io/builtin/turf' with no type to list Turf's own actions. |
| `provider_version` | string | no | Provider version (e.g. '5.0.0'). Required for a registry provider. |
| `resource_type` | string | no | Managed resource type to describe (e.g. 'aws_s3_bucket'). One of resource_type, datasource_type, action_type, function. |
| `datasource_type` | string | no | Data source type to describe (e.g. 'aws_ami'). |
| `action_type` | string | no | Action type to describe (e.g. 'aws_lambda_invoke', or Turf's own 'turf_action'). |
| `function` | string | no | Provider-defined function to describe (e.g. 'rfc3339_parse' of hashicorp/time), called as provider::&lt;local name>::&lt;function>(…) where the module's required_providers declares the provider. |
